arguments.cmd:
cadcheck verify --help 2>&1
cadcheck assembly --help 2>&1

result.stdout:

                         scad

positional arguments:
  scad

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --out-dir OUT_DIR
  --requirements REQUIREMENTS
usage: cadcheck export [-h] [-D DEFINES] [--timeout TIMEOUT] [--part PART]

                       scad

positional arguments:
  scad

options:

  -D DEFINES
  --timeout TIMEOUT
  --part PART
